answer: Directed Shortest Path Congestion Routing This mechanism restricts agent influence by measuring communication friction across a dense graph. Every message must wander through a decentralized relay network rather than direct links. The network calculates routing capacity using a quartz crystal oscillator clock reference to limit throughput on high-density subgraphs. An attacker trying to flood the system cannot simply spawn new nodes; they must provision real routing hardware to secure a port in each local harbor hub.
